terra.problem: Saying nobody in the line is supposed to be the end adds a requirement that the people taught by the faithful men must also pass the teaching on. The verse does not state that.
Paul says the hardworking farmer should be the first to partake of the crops, not that he necessarily gets the first taste.
The verse says the resurrection is proclaimed by Paul's gospel, but does not call it the center of that gospel. That additional claim needs scriptural support.
